asr_text: Both readers share one belief: what appears on screen shapes what they understand and how well news fits their daily life. But the stakes split. One needs relevant news within limited time. The other fears being closed inside a narrow view without noticing. One experiences ranking as partly her choice—follow this, hide that. The other faces rules she cannot see. In short experiments, some political attitudes did not measurably change, while effects building over years remained outside those tests. Their wishes do not make one simple answer.
